newsitem.title: USA: Gardner Denver to acquire Tamrock unit.
newsitem.headline: Gardner Denver to acquire Tamrock unit.

text.p: Gardner Denver Machinery Inc, a maker of air compressor and blower products, said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Oy Tamrotor AB, a subsidiary of Tamrock Corp of Tampere, Finland, for FIM 135, or about $26 million.
Tamrotor manufactures lubricated screw compressor air ends, Gardner Denver said.

"The addition of Tamrotor provides Gardner Denver with a manufacturing base in Europe as well as market penetration in several European compressor markets," Gardner Denver chief executive Ross Centanni said in a news release.
He said the company did not expect the deal to be dilutive to 1997 earnings.
Gardner Denver shares were down 3/4 at 29 Monday.
